Wrathful Mantle.note: Protection gives a save bonus; no retaliatory burst.

Wrathful Weapon.note: Runic Weapon enhances a weapon; no alignment damage.

Wreath of Blades.note: Weapon Storm (emanation) strikes creatures around you once rather than lingering.

Yellow Sign.note: PF2e has no trigger-glyph Symbol spells; store the effect in a Rune Trap ritual or use the listed spell directly.

Youthful Appearance.note: Illusory Disguise can make a target look younger (illusion, not polymorph).

Zephyr's Fleetness.note: Tailwind grants a smaller Speed boost to one creature.

Zone of Silence.note: Silence mutes a target; Zone of Silence instead keeps sound from leaving an area.

Zone of Truth.note: Ring of Truth reveals lies spoken in an area.
